C0744.title: Anhui Village Director Extorted and Accepted Bribes in Poverty Alleviation Work
C0744.summary: In September 2019, the Anhui discipline inspection authority reported that Ding Hongyan, former Party branch secretary of Shinan Village in Shicun Town, Yongqiao District, Suzhou, repeatedly solicited and accepted money and goods from residents while handling subsistence allowance and poverty household applications from 2008 to 2018. She also improperly secured subsistence allowance for her mother-in-law and received a Party disciplinary sanction in August 2019.
